description: Elections Commission - Order under Section 38(3) of the (Local Authority Election Ordinance) Puttalam District - Reserved
reasoning: This gazette notice pertains to electoral processes under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the postponement of a poll date for Local Authorities elections due to funding issues and outlines the procedure for setting a new date. This content falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves election scheduling, notifications, and administrative matters related to the electoral process conducted by the Election Commission and Returning Officer.
